contests.title: Bartholomew Consolidated School Corporation — School operating tax

provenance.sourceOrg: Indiana Department of Local Government Finance
provenance.quote:
Shall Bartholomew Consolidated School Corporation continue to increase
property taxes paid to the school corporation for no more than eight (8) years for
the purpose of funding and maintaining competitive compensation for teachers
and staff and maintaining student safety by imposing a property tax rate that does
not exceed $0.156 and results in a maximum annual amount that does not exceed
$10,100,000. If this operating referendum public question is NOT approved by
the voters, for a median residence of $250,000, the property’s annual tax bill
would decrease by $190 per year. If this operating referendum public question is
approved by the voters, it would be a renewal of the most recent operating
referendum public question passed in 2020 with a property tax rate of $0.156.

contests.title: Tri-Central Community Schools — School operating tax

provenance.sourceOrg: Indiana Department of Local Government Finance
provenance.quote:
Shall Tri-Central Community Schools increase property taxes paid to the school
corporation for no more than eight (8) years for the purpose of funding and
maintaining daily educational operations, including recruiting and retaining
teachers and staff, supporting essential safety initiatives, and maintaining class
sizes, academic programs and opportunities to meet the learning needs of all
students in response to reductions in property tax revenue by imposing a property
tax rate that does not exceed $0.24 and results in a maximum annual amount that
does not exceed $1,100,000. If this operating referendum public question is
approved by the voters, for a median residence of $150,000, the property's annual
property tax bill would increase by $143 per year.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a school operating property-tax levy for no more than eight years for teacher and staff compensation and student safety. The rate is capped at $0.156 per $100 of assessed value, with an annual levy cap of $10,100,000. The official illustration estimates a $190 annual decrease if voters reject it for a $250,000,median residence.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve the renewal; the official question estimates the stated median-residence tax decrease.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a school operating property-tax levy for no more than eight years for daily school operations, teachers and staff, safety, class sizes and academic programs. The rate is capped at $0.24 per $100 of assessed value, with an annual levy cap of $1,100,000. The official illustration estimates a $143 annual increase if voters approve it for a $150,000,median residence.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed levy and its stated caps.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve this proposed levy through this question.
